checkpoint_slice.authority: Infer the owner from the authenticated human or delegation sponsor. Reporting requires current contribution and credential ceilings; reads require current read authority. Direct humans see only their own human/delegation history; agents see only their exact delegation/client origin. Task sharing does not share checkpoints, and write-only OAuth receipts do not grant reads.
checkpoint_slice.storage: Immutable exact-task/project/owner/origin rows with canonical body hashes. Human origins have no delegation/client pair; delegated origins bind the sponsor. Retained human identity, not a historical creation-epoch cutoff, owns history. Revoking an origin does not erase the human owner's history.
checkpoint_slice.delivery: Author/origin filtering precedes newest-first bounded history. A coherent current-parent sentinel handles authorized empty views. Closed inputs, original authority capture, command batch/cache checks and actual post-Hub response/body selection protect minimal exact receipts while preserving committed history.
checkpoint_slice.ordinary_work_unchanged: No comments, context injection, task-version increment, measurement, notification, runner command or generic outward audit/feed category. Ordinary progress stays task-visible.
checkpoint_slice.native_controls: Registered two-Worker lifecycle, exact delegation separation and owner history after origin revoke; write-only Reviewer receipts; independently completed contribution and OAuth revocation before forwarding original bound batches; repaired same-key retry.
checkpoint_slice.synthetic_contribution_cut: A second direct domain Hub intentionally bypasses the serialized production FIFO to prove the D1 atomic backstop. This is not reachable competing production-command concurrency.
checkpoint_slice.native_oauth_limit: Retained native OAuth metadata is synthetic. Genuine authenticated exchanges are separate mounted MCP fixtures, not native authorization proof.
checkpoint_slice.expiry_limit: The checkpoint-specific staged expiry case rewrites expiry metadata; it does not certify unchanged natural expiry.
checkpoint_slice.bounds_scope: Instrumented prebatch-cut checkpoint command preparations only; lifecycle, reads and Worker/DO internals are excluded.
checkpoint_slice.browser_scope: Compiled on-demand composition, canonical-refresh confirmation, keyboard focus, denial clearing/explicit retry and reflow at 1280px/390px in light/dark. All responses are intercepted synthetic presentation fixtures, not browser-to-server authorization proof.
checkpoint_slice.design: Impeccable carries the approved Work Map tokens into one on-demand section with one Add checkpoint action and a Save/Cancel pair during composition; no new default board action. Synchronous single-flight admission prevents duplicate saves, and task/human-scoped revision checks preserve newer drafts, including edited-then-restored text.

native_storage.rollback: Complete canonical snapshots start after completed independent cuts; rejected batches add no business or Hub effects. Legitimate writes, safe audit/cache history and repaired retries retain their expected committed effects.
